title: Household Add-On Membership: prepayment discount, transfer basis and name-change basis
content:
## Scope
This document states, for each Household Add-On Membership tier, the discount rate for prepaying dues in a lump sum and the lengths of prepayment offered, whether the add-on may be transferred to a different primary member and the flat fee for doing so, and whether the dependent's name on file may be changed and the flat fee for doing so.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Prepay discount rate | Prepay lengths offered | Transfer to new primary allowed | Transfer fee | Dependent name change allowed | Name-change fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spouse Add-On | 5 percent | 6 or 12 months | not allowed | $0.00 | allowed | $0.00 |
| Domestic Partner Add-On | 5 percent | 6 or 12 months | not allowed | $0.00 | allowed | $0.00 |
| Dependent Child Add-On | 5 percent | 6 or 12 months | allowed | $0.00 | allowed | $0.00 |
| Young Adult Add-On | 5 percent | 6 or 12 months | allowed | $0.00 | allowed | $0.00 |
| Senior Parent Add-On | 5 percent | 6 or 12 months | allowed | $0.00 | allowed | $0.00 |
| Household Multi-Add-On | 8 percent | 6 or 12 months | allowed | $0.00 | allowed | $0.00 |

## Points of judgement
- Every tier offers the same two prepayment lengths, 6 months or 12 months, and every current tier's transfer fee and name-change fee both read $0.00, so where a transfer or a name change is allowed for a tier it carries no additional flat charge today.
- The Household Multi-Add-On is the only tier whose prepay discount rate departs from the shared 5 percent, at 8 percent instead.
- The Spouse Add-On and the Domestic Partner Add-On are the only tiers that do not allow transfer of the add-on to a different primary member; every other tier allows it.
- Every tier of the Household Add-On Membership allows the dependent's name on file to be changed.
